changelog: Fixed /expertise and the mechanic inspection target option failing on client.
Added VehicleLife system: persistent VIN, real mileage tracking, previous owners & accident log, 7-component progressive wear, hidden faults, and realistic driving symptoms.
Added Public Vehicle Logbook (/carhistory & target) and Mechanic Expertise (/expertise & target) with targeted component repairs, full overhaul, and automatic Benny's workshop repair sync.
Added live VehicleLife settings tab in /conf_acn_bennys and automatic startup SQL migration for existing vehicles.
Live preview: hovering a part, colour, tint, xenon, livery or extra now shows it on the car instantly, and it goes back when you move away.
New Custom mods tab in /conf_acn_bennys: rename, re-price, add a picture to or hide any mod, for all cars or one specific car (addon cars included).
Part pictures no longer need screenshots: every option is previewed live on the car. The unreliable capture tool was removed.
Workshop camera: mouse rotation is no longer inverted.
More compact workshop interface so the vehicle stays visible.
New /conf_acn_bennys admin panel with a colourful Pop / Cartoon design: search, per-setting reset and live preview of both themes.
Brand new interface plus a blue 'Bluebird' theme, switchable live in game by admins.
Every GTA customization is now available: Benny's parts, wheel types, neons, extras, liveries and more.
Automatic part images with the /bennys_capture admin command.
Customization presets, random build, reset to stock and employee discount.
